title: I would recommend an...
text:
I would recommend an early morning tour as it was extremely hot at 4:30 in the afternoon during the end of May.
The guide was very knowledgeable and we were able to cover a lot of ground despite the heat.
author: Laura_d

title: Great walk through Granada
text: A very informative walk through Granada and the narrow streets of the old city.  Covered history from multiple civilizations.  A great tour.
author: Vadim_B
